model.jaffle_shop.exposed_view.why: exposures read it (products_dashboard): it stays a view for them, and its readers that move (1) read a table of it

model.jaffle_shop.heavy_view.why: its plan holds memory (a join, aggregate, sort or window): built once as a table

model.jaffle_shop.shared_view.why: 2 models read it: built once as a table, read by each

model.jaffle_shop.stg_locations.why: its one reader is all that reads it and its plan only streams: inlined into it, nothing to store or build

model.jaffle_shop.stuck_view.why: it can't move itself (syntax:semi_structured, materialization:view); a table of it built on Snowflake lets its readers move (1), and the view stays

edits.diff:
--- a/models/marts/customer_status.sql
+++ b/models/marts/customer_status.sql
@@ -1,2 +1,4 @@
+{{ config(adapter='lakecompute') }}
+
 -- Snowflake-only scalar functions: binds fail on DuckDB
 -- (iff, nvl, zeroifnull, unquoted datediff date part).
@@ -4,7 +6,7 @@
     customers.customer_id,
     customers.customer_name,
-    iff(customers.count_lifetime_orders > 1, 'returning', 'new') as status,
-    nvl(customers.last_order_date, customers.first_order_date) as last_seen_date,
-    zeroifnull(customers.lifetime_spend) as lifetime_spend,
-    datediff(day, customers.first_order_date, customers.last_order_date) as tenure_days
+    CAST((CASE WHEN (CAST((CUSTOMERS.COUNT_LIFETIME_ORDERS > CAST(1 AS DECIMAL(18,0))) AS BOOL)) THEN ('returning') ELSE ('new') END) AS VARCHAR) as status,
+    CAST((CASE WHEN ((CUSTOMERS.LAST_ORDER_DATE)) IS NOT NULL THEN (CUSTOMERS.LAST_ORDER_DATE) ELSE (CUSTOMERS.FIRST_ORDER_DATE) END) AS DATE) as last_seen_date,
+    CAST((coalesce((CUSTOMERS.LIFETIME_SPEND), 0)) AS DECIMAL(28,2)) as lifetime_spend,
+    CAST(datediff('day', CUSTOMERS.FIRST_ORDER_DATE, CUSTOMERS.LAST_ORDER_DATE) AS DECIMAL(9,0)) as tenure_days
 from {{ ref('customers') }} as customers
